Build the SHARED READ all four deep axes ride: repr_of : Ty -> Repr, a pure
cursor projection of the type the graph already proved. The five-class ADT
Repr = RI32|RI64|RF64|RF32|RV128 (never width == 4/8 — drift mode 8); repr_width
(4/8/16) and repr_wat (the WAT token) by ADT match.

repr_of is H6-exhaustive over all 14 Ty constructors: alias-strip / refinement-
unwrap FIRST (TAlias -> inner, TRefined -> base — representation is the
underlying value's property), TFloat => RF64 (the live decider ty_to_wasm_type
left unreached), and every word-kind (pointers, tags, the unresolved-TVar floor)
=> RI32 — a handle IS a 32-bit word, so the floor and the pointer representation
are ONE fact. RI64/RF32/RV128 are present as arms but reachable only when STEP 1
lands their gradient-INPUT pins, so no path fabricates them from the current Ty.

ty_to_wasm_type (backends/wasm.mn) becomes a reader: ty |> repr_of |> repr_wat —
one decision home, the parallel per-Ty width table deleted (Carried-Truth: less
code). Output byte-identical to the prior table (RF64->f64, all else->i32).

Gate: existing micros byte-identical (ev2/4/8=57, ev5=21, ev16=18 — LAW 7, no
emit path perturbed); new micro repr-width=40 proves the width arithmetic round-
trips through the seed; drift-audit clean. The value gate (repr_of(TFloat)==RF64)
lands with STEP 1's first wheel caller — peer Hβ.repr.read-value-gate.

tokensafe/462f106:
Revenue ladder phases 1-4: build the upgrade path from free lite to paid.

Score breakdown (`score_breakdown` field) maps each risk check to its point
contribution — agents and compliance tools can see exactly why a token scored
the way it did. Lite endpoint enriched with `can_sell`, `authorities_renounced`,
`has_liquidity`, `token_age_hours`, and delta fields (`risk_score_delta`,
`previous_risk_score`, `previous_risk_level`) to drive paid check conversion.

New `/v1/decide` endpoint returns a binary SAFE/RISKY/UNKNOWN decision with
configurable threshold — the simplest possible integration for sniper bots.

Three tiered batch routes behind x402 paywall with volume discounts:
- `/v1/check/batch/small`  — up to 5 tokens,  $0.025 ($0.005/ea)
- `/v1/check/batch/medium` — up to 20 tokens, $0.08  ($0.004/ea)
- `/v1/check/batch/large`  — up to 50 tokens, $0.15  ($0.003/ea)

CDN headers on free endpoints (Cache-Control public 5min, CORS, Vary) and
private no-store on paid endpoints. Error-aware negative cache TTL (RPC_ERROR
5s, TOKEN_NOT_FOUND 15s) replaces flat 30s for all errors.

247 tests (was 212), all passing.

bits/46e4426:
Morgan's first device session said it plainly: the stage was strangled
by a stack of buttons. Now the stage fills everything above one slim
transport bar (round record button, play, scrubbable playhead with
beat ticks, undo, kit toggle) and every other control lives in a kit
sheet that slides over the stage instead of shrinking it.

The kit's spine is the puppet rail: the cast as chips whose order IS
draw order, back to front. Selecting a chip offers front/back/center/
drop, which gives explicit layers, drop discoverability, and rescue
for puppets parked offstage, because pointer coordinates now run well
past the frame: puppets drag off through the wings and enter from
outside, and staging can park them there on purpose. Placement modes
float cancel/keep pills over the stage. Verified with lint, 33 tests,
the e2e proof, and a phone-size screenshot of the layout.
stoop/46d7f25:
The desk signed every column of short scraps "Both", on a scene of one or
of four, and whoever wrote them. A column is now signed by the one person
who wrote it, or as made together when several did, and together reads
"Both" only for a pair and "Together" otherwise; a scene of one is not
offered it at all. Pulling scraps twice put every piece in the tray twice.
A piece now remembers the scraps it came from, and new short scraps join
the column already waiting.

Ringing the bell filed every live piece as published and took it off the
desk, including the ones that never fit on the pages. What ships now is
what was compiled, and the rest waits for the next issue. A recompile
after a cut left the cut piece's heading and photograph behind; pages the
last compile filled are emptied, and handwork is left alone.

A format change mapped pages by index, so a bigger format buried the back
cover in the middle and a smaller one cut it off along with every page
past the fold. The cover and back cover now stay put, inner pages keep
their order, and pages that do not fit are set aside, said so, and come
back where they were.

Backspace in the marker's text box deleted the whole cutting, and in the
scraps box it deleted one on the press behind the drawer; arrows and
brackets were hijacked the same way. Cutting keys now stand down while
anybody is typing in a field. Undoing a cutting took back every word
typed since, because typing was never a step; it is now, taken on the way
into the field. Undo also reached back past the bell and could paste the
shipped issue onto the new draft, and a drag wrote the whole store to the
device on every pointer move.
